science.title: What BHB actually does
science.text: When you cut carbs, your body makes ketones — like BHB (beta-hydroxybutyric acid) — to burn fat for fuel. But getting there takes days, and the 'keto flu' can hit on the way. Exogenous BHB salts give your body ketones directly, helping you reach and hold ketosis with cleaner energy and fewer bumps. MCT powder adds fast-burning fats to keep the state fuelled.

items.q: What is BHB and what does it do?
items.a: BHB (beta-hydroxybutyrate) is the main ketone your body makes when burning fat. Taking it as a supplement raises your blood ketones directly — giving your body and brain clean energy and helping you reach ketosis.

items.q: Do I have to be on a keto diet?
items.a: It works best alongside a low-carb or keto diet. On a high-carb diet your body burns glucose first, so you'll get less from exogenous ketones.

items.q: Will it help with the 'keto flu'?
items.a: Many people find supplemental BHB and electrolytes ease the fatigue and headaches that can come with the carb-to-fat transition.
